steps.tx: A highly effective long-acting injectable progestogen is **depot medroxyprogesterone acetate**, administered as a deep intramuscular injection of one hundred and fifty milligrams. Provided free in Indian public health facilities under the Antara Programme, each injection provides robust, coitus-independent contraception lasting twelve weeks, with a perfect-use Pearl index of 0.2.
steps.say: DMPA delivers three months of highly effective reversible contraception via an intramuscular injection.

steps.tx: Intramuscular microcrystals form a slow-release repository that provides **complete ovulation inhibition**. Circulating medroxyprogesterone suppresses the hypothalamic GnRH pulse generator and abolishes the mid-cycle pituitary LH surge. Simultaneously, it induces marked cervical mucus thickening and profound endometrial glandular atrophy, rendering gamete passage and implantation impossible.
steps.say: DMPA abolishes the LH surge to completely prevent ovulation while thickening cervical mucus.

rows: Suppresses LH surge and blunts FSH

steps.tx: Administration must take place within the initial five days of the menstrual cycle, with a **four-week grace period** allowed for subsequent injections. If a patient returns up to four weeks late, the repeat injection may be administered safely without requiring backup barrier contraception or pregnancy testing, provided unprotected intercourse has not occurred beyond that window.
steps.say: DMPA repeat injections can be given up to four weeks late without compromising contraceptive protection.

right.title: Grace Window Protocols
points: Up to 4 weeks late: inject immediately
Use barrier backup for 7 days if late

steps.tx: The most common bleeding pattern associated with long-term DMPA administration is **secondary amenorrhoea development**. While irregular spotting and breakthrough bleeding predominate during the first six months, up to fifty-five percent of women become completely amenorrhoeic by the end of one year, rising to seventy percent by two years. This amenorrhoea helps resolve iron-deficiency anaemia.
steps.say: Amenorrhoea develops in most users by one to two years, providing relief from heavy menses.

steps.tx: Due to prolonged pituitary suppression and persistent tissue storage in peripheral adipocytes, DMPA causes a **delayed return of fertility**. The median time to conception following the final injection is nine to ten months, with some women taking up to eighteen months. Patients planning pregnancy in the near future should choose an alternative method.
steps.say: Fertility return may be delayed up to ten months following the last DMPA injection.

left.title: Fertility Delay Mechanism
points: Slow release from lipid tissue depots

right.title: Long-Term Prognosis
points: Conception rates equal other methods by 2 years

steps.tx: Sustained hypoestrogenism from profound ovarian suppression induces a reversible **bone mineral density reduction**. Circulating estradiol levels drop to early follicular phase ranges, stimulating osteoclast-mediated bone resorption. However, bone loss stabilizes after two years and bone mineral density rebounds completely toward baseline following discontinuation, without increasing postmenopausal fracture risk.
steps.say: DMPA causes temporary bone density loss that stabilizes and reverses upon discontinuation.

steps.tx: A common metabolic side effect of medroxyprogesterone acetate is progressive **systemic weight gain**. Through hypothalamic appetite stimulation and mild glucocorticoid receptor cross-reactivity, users gain an average of two to four kilograms after one to two years of continuous therapy. Nutritional counselling and regular aerobic exercise help mitigate progressive weight gain.
steps.say: Appetite stimulation from progestational activity leads to moderate weight gain in many users.

right.title: Clinical Management
points: Method switching if weight gain is unacceptable

steps.tx: Under WHO medical eligibility criteria, DMPA is classified as category one or two for **women with sickle cell disease** and epilepsy. In sickle cell anaemia, DMPA significantly reduces painful vaso-occlusive crises by stabilizing erythrocyte membranes. Unlike oral contraceptives, DMPA efficacy is not compromised by hepatic cytochrome P450-inducing antiseizure medications like carbamazepine or phenytoin.
steps.say: DMPA reduces sickle cell crises and maintains full efficacy alongside enzyme-inducing anticonvulsants.
